cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land called Bārakūru-rājya included in the Bārakūru-rājya and of certain tolls, made by Mahāpradhāna Anappa-Oḍeya to Toḷjahara Śaṅkara-Nāyaka, who was administering the latter in the month of Ādi, to build a matha attached to the temple of Haṭṭara-Nārāyaṇa-dēva at Bārakūru and feed therein six Brahmans (daily). cells.place: On a slab standing in the field called 'Sāḷeya Subbaṇa-gadde.'
cells.remarks: Registers a gift of land made by the several Śeṭṭis of Āriyakēri for offerings etc. in the temples of Viṇā-yakadēva and others. Mentions the grant of land for the expenses of special services in these temples on the Dīpāvaḷi and other important days. Chaṭḍarasa-Oḍeya was governing the Bārākūru-rājya under the orders of the King and the governor, Siṅgāṇa-Daṇṇāyaka. At the end there are four lines of writing in Nāgarī characters which seem to refer to Brahmans and Vēdapāṭha.

cells.remarks: Records a gift of land by the family of Māni[bha]-raṇavāradēva and as the mistress of the Western sea. States that Baṅkādēva, Narasīha-Hoggade, Mahāprad-āna Āna Sōmaṇṇa-Sēnabōva, Kumāra Bijjaṇa-arasa, M h prabhu Peruma-Sōnabōva etc., and the Mahājanas of Sāntavūra met in the presence of Her Majesty and resolved that 32 mūḍe of paddy from the land endowed by Kiṭṭihaṭṭudeya should be measured by Kēśava-Seṭṭi of the Baṅga (family) to the god Muḍādēva at Śivapuram.
